Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Thank you, Phineas. (Cut to the dining room. The gang is gathered around the table in their pajamas.) In researching for my very first slumber party, in which I am so excited to stay up past my regular bedtime of 9

Name: Buford
Dialog: You'll never make it!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: (getting out a binder) …I present to you the ultimate sleepover checklist! Movies, a pillow fight, ice cream sundae bar, some mores (s'mores)…

Name: Buford
Dialog: No, no, no, no, no! Ya gotta have pranks! Prank calls, Prank Sinatra, prank hand in warm water, stuff like that.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (approaches the gang) All right, I am not dealing with you guys tonight. Stacy and Vanessa are on their way over and we're having our own sleepover with our own activities. Besides, you already built your wacky doohickey, (points to Mom) which you missed!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Huh?

Name: Candace
Dialog: So I am officially off doohickey duty. (The doorbell rings. She gets the door and greets Vanessa and Stacy. She and Stacy scream at each other.)

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: 'Sup?

Name: Candace
Dialog: (hugs Vanessa) I'm so glad you could come!

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Me, too! Well, my dad was also driving me nuts.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Hey, Vanessa! Vanessa! Hey, Vanessa! Vanessa! It's "Jingle Bells"! Listen! (He slams the cabinet doors to the rhythm of "Jingle Bells", but we only get so far as "Jingle all…"; Vanessa sighs)

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Yeah, so glad to be here.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: (approaches the gang) Ooh, this looks fun!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (to Vanessa) You remember my brothers?

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Yeah. Hey, guys!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (to Stacy) Oh, don't talk to the tiny ones. (pulls Stacy away and pushes her and Vanessa upstairs.) Upstairs for some real fun!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Okay. (yawn) There's snacks in the sink and dishes in the fridge. I'm just gonna have some chamomile tea, which knocks me out. (goes upstairs with her teacup) So you guys have fun.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Gentlemen and lady, start your slumbers! (The gang disperses except…)

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Hey, where's Perry? (Cut to Perry sleeping by the fireplace.) Oh, there you are. 'Night, Perry!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: (appears on his car's monitor) Agent P, we're gonna need you to pull an all-night stakeout over at Doof's.

Name: Carl
Dialog: Where should I put the chips and dip, sir?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: The only dip here is you, Carl. Sorry, Agent P. Tonight's the finale of Acquaintances.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Having a little watch party. I'm so excited to find out what happens to Antonio or that conventionally handsome Ryan. Anyhoo, I'm sure you're seeing that giant megaphone there on Doof's balcony. He hasn't done anything with it all day, which is odd, as he—

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (looks out his window) Is this a stakeout, Perry the Platypus? I-I see you. Just come up. We'll have a stake-in. Come on in. Come on up.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Oops! Byeeeeeeee! (Hangs up)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ah, Perry the Platypus. Come on in, take a seat. I'm just looking for the right… Channel!! (laughs; He pushed a button on his remote and the chair's arms trap Perry.) Now that you're nice and comfy, I can prattle on about my improbable pet peeve.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Every day, when I go downstairs to get my mail, my neighbor, Tyler, is down there spoiling the ending of every show to my other neighbors.

Name: Tyler
Dialog: …and then you find out he was faking his coma!

Name: Neighbor
Dialog: Hey! I haven't seen that episode yet!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: And now he's getting a rep as the most evil guy in our building! (Cut back to present. He is popping some popcorn.) A title that should rightly go to me! It's my name on the sign! It's my name up there! So it got me thinking, if he's the most evil by spoiling things to people in the building, what if I spoiled things to the entire Tri-State Area? Y'see, tonight is the two-hour finale of a very popular show, Acquaintances.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Norm figured out how to get the Drusselsteinian VPN feed so I can watch it early. I'll find out the ending and then I'll go over to that giant megaphone and yell out all the spoilers to everyone! Who's the evil one now, Tyler? I know what you're thinking

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Okay, first item on the checklist is to watch a scary movie.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Well, good thing we've got the ultimate movie-watching experience!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Ferb-vision! I know earlier we built one of our most amazing inventions ever.

Name: Buford
Dialog: We were all here. You don't hafta describe it.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: You're right, but then Ferb threw this together before dinner.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: It's a twofer!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Inside the climate-controlled dome are comfy cantilevered seats, which react to what's going on in the movie.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: (snores)

Name: Buford
Dialog: Baljeet!!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: (jolts awake) I am awake! I am awake!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: The best part, the base is made entirely of kettle corn, and it's constantly popping, so you can catch it in midair!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Okay, grab your movie goggles, everyone!

Name: Candace
Dialog: I am so excited for some solid girl time with you guys tonight! I thought we could enjoy this charcuterie board, then play truth-or-dare, then watch a movie on my laptop!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: (looking out the window, sees the dome outside) Uh, maybe don't look outside, Candace.

Name: Candace
Dialog: What?! They're doing a twofer?!? Ugh! I'm getting Mom!

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: C'mon, Candace, there's like a million other things we can do tonight besides busting your brothers. We can do anything! Well, anything but sleep.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Dress up in cloaks and monster masks, to give your brothers a scare!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Okay, but what about llamas?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Did you hear what Jeremy said?

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Buford, stop eavesdropping!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Ooh, we can confess our deepest darkest secrets and emotions! Or whatever!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: There's so much at stake,

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I gotta stay awake... OW!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I'm just resting my eyes!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Come on! It's the commercial break!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Wow, Candace, you didn't really take anything away from that, did you?

Name: Buford
Dialog: (to Baljeet) Okay, Sleepmaster General, it's 9

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: I am insulted! I will have you know that I... (falls asleep and snores)

Name: Buford
Dialog: Knew it! Prime for drawin'! (gasps) Even better, maybe I can borrow some makeup from Candace!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Okay, what'd I miss? Anything spoilery?

Name: Woman on TV
Dialog: Antonio, how could you do that terrible thing I don't need to describe?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Wait, who's this guy? Who's the guy with the mustache?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Okay, Stacy, truth or dare?

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Uh, truth.

Name: Candace
Dialog: What's the grossest thing that ever happened to you?

Name: Buford
Dialog: Ladies, I was lookin' for some makeup to prank Baljeet, but I see now we're playin' truth-or-dare. Dare me anythin'. I only do dares.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (throws pillow at him) Get out!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Vanessa; (catches pillow) Uh, wait! Not so fast. Okay, Buford, I dare you to dunk your head in the toilet.

Name: Buford
Dialog: That's how I style my hair. Think bigger!

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Okay, how about go downstairs and take a bite of Perry's food?

Name: Buford
Dialog: I already did that when I came in. Next!

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: I dare you to let me give you a makeover. (boops Buford)

Name: Buford
Dialog: Fine, but I'm an autumn.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Ugh! Vanessa, just give him some blush and get him out of here. Stacy!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Yo, Ferb, can that thing get the finale of Acquaintances?

Name: Man
Dialog: (clears throat)

Name: Ferb
Dialog: Indeed, but can you handle the 273K?

Name: Candace
Dialog: No! Don't encourage him! Vanessa!

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: (laughs) Buford, you look just like Queen Victoria!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Yeah, I'm pullin' it off.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Slay, Queenie!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (finally snaps) That's it! I'm putting an end to this and getting Mom!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Candace, maybe it would be cool if we could all have fun together.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (murmurs) Mom....!!!!!!!!!!! (Runs out of the room)

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Come on, Candace!

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: We dare you not to get your mom! (Candace has fled; to Stacy) Welp, if you can't beat 'em...

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Join 'em in a hi-def circular dome TV?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mom! Mom, wake up! Wake up, Mom!

Name: Linda
Dialog: (snores loudly)

Name: Candace
Dialog: Wow, that chamomile tea really does knock her out.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Well, pardon me, Your Majesty.

Name: Buford
Dialog: 'Sup, chief?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Hey! Perry the Platypus, how did you—

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Why do I always use so much butter? (shakes the popcorn off, and lunges at Perry, but lies down on the chair Perry was sitting in) Y'know, I'm so groggy. That turkey really packs a punch.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mom, look outside! Wake up!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Hey!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ow! Oh, I am awake now.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (grunts) Maybe… if I get you… outside…! (bumps into a ledge)

Name: Perry
Dialog: (chatters)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Perry the Platypus! How did you… (Perry pours the tea into Doof's mouth. He falls right back asleep. The inator is about to blow. Perry punches it in slow motion and it explodes out the window shooting off a beam.)

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mom, look! You see that?!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Candace, is this some kind of ridiculous internet prank?! It's like, a thousand o'clock!

Name: Candace
Dialog: But but but but...

Name: Linda
Dialog: And why is your father having a full formal English tea with Buford?

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Tea, Your Majesty?

Name: Neighbor
Dialog: Did you see the finale last night?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: No, I fell asleep. I'll have to watch it tonight.

Name: Tyler
Dialog: (runs past) Antonio and Ryan found out they had a mutual acquaintance!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (sighs) Curse you, Tyler the Spoiler!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: No-no, we are not changing the jingle!
